//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Realistic Bees -> Config

Enable Realistic Bees.//: Whether Realistic Bees is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart.

beeSizeModifier.//: This value determines the size of a bee. By default 0.25, which means they are 1/4th of their vanilla size. Set to 1.0 to disable the different bee size feature. min: 0.01, max: 5

extraBeeSpawnsPerBee.//: In order to make bees a little more common. Whenever a bee naturally spawns, the mod spawns an additional 'extraBeeSpawnsPerBee' bees. min: 0, max: 50

beeHiveBeeSpace.//: How many bees should be able to enter the hive in total. Minecraft's default is 3, but bees are a lot smaller so there should be more space. min: 0, max: 50

preventBeeSuffocationDamage.//: The smaller (baby) bees can sometimes do something unexpected with their AI and get suffocation damage. Preventing this damage fixes them disappearing.

preventBeeCampfireDamage.//: Smaller bees fly closer to a campfire placed below their hive and can get burned by it. When enabled, bees take no damage from campfires.

nectarDeliveriesPerHoneyLevel.//: How many nectar deliveries it takes on average to raise a hive's honey level by one. Minecraft's default is 1, but with more bees per hive the honey fills up a lot faster. min: 1, max: 20

hivesRepopulateFromFullHoney.//: When enabled, a hive that fills up with honey and still has space uses up the honey to release a new baby bee.
